# Goat.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/goat-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/goat-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Goat.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Goat.com for Fashion Apparel Data in Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-goat-com-fashion-apparel)
- **Code:** [`goat.py`](goat.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Product pages](results/products.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Goat product pages
- Goat search pages

## Functions

- `scrape_products(urls)` → `dict`: scrape goat.com product pages for product data
- `scrape_search(query, max_pages=10)` → `List[Dict]`: Scrape goat.com search pages for product listings using the new web-api.

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import goat


async def main():
    search = await goat.scrape_search("pumar dark", max_pages=3)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/products.json`](results/products.json): `brandName`, `color`, `designer`, `details`, `gender`, `ageGroups`, `id`, `internalShot`, `maximumOfferCents`, `midsole`, `minimumOfferCents`, `name`, `nickname`, `productCategory`, `productType`, `releaseDate`, `releaseDateName`, `season`, `silhouette`, `sizeBrand`, `sizeRange`, `sizeType`, `sizeUnit`, `sku`, `slug`, `specialDisplayPriceCents`, `specialType`, `status`, `upperMaterial`, `taxonomyLevel1`, `taxonomyLevel2`, `availableSizesNew`, `availableSizesNewV2`, `availableSizesNewWithDefects`, `availableSizesUsed`, `sizeOptions`, `lowestPriceCents`, `newLowestPriceCents`, `usedLowestPriceCents`, `productTaxonomy`, … (31 more)
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `variantsList`, `id`, `status`, `slug`, `title`, `pictureUrl`, `inStock`, `category`, `seasonYear`, `productType`, `localizedRetailPriceCents`, `brandName`, `activity`, `seasonType`, `underRetail`, `gender`, `activitiesList`, `silhouette`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`goat.py`](goat.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/goat-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
